description.value: The Gray Olive Cafeteria is a sit-down breakfast and brunch spot on Hastings Street in Burnaby, known for creative egg dishes, specialty benedicts, and brioche-bun sandwiches. The menu spans approachable comfort food — from a Pork Belly Benny with kabocha squash to an Impossible patty Veggie Burger — with an extensive drinks list including Thai iced tea and specialty lattes. The restaurant uses a waitlist system and takes reservations, pointing to a popular neighbourhood destination.
